title: Correction to: Transgenerational effects of imidacloprid on Sclerodermus alternatusi (Hymenoptera: Bethylidae) based on age-stage, two-sex life table
content: This is a correction to: Bingchuan Zhang, Xue Wang, Zaiyan Chen, Shulin He, Shan Xu, Fei Li, Cao Zhou, Transgenerational effects of imidacloprid on Sclerodermus alternatusi (Hymenoptera: Bethylidae) based on age-stage, two-sex life table, Environmental Entomology, 2024;, nvae112, https://doi.org/10.1093/ee/nvae112
